derivation: Exact rational Chebyshev restriction to the union of all source record boundaries; coefficient absolute sums bound position and derivative on each complete interval. Add the full DE441 representation and PLU060 coefficient-conversion bounds. The center distance lower bound uses each axis constant term minus its remaining absolute coefficient sum; For r = position error / distance lower bound, 3440*r/(1-r) encloses direction error in arcminutes without a transcendental-function rounding assumption. For H=(1-w)D+wC, H-C=(1-w)(D-C), with derivative bounded by rate difference plus max|dw/dTDB| times position difference; max|dw/dTDB|=1.875/32. Coefficient conversion bounds separately enclose binary64 km-to-AU division over every record.
limitations: Bounds concern the source polynomials and representation, not independent ephemeris physical accuracy or all floating-point evaluation operations.
Derivative bounds are per TDB day; native converts to per TT day and tests that conversion.
Horizons geometric and observer target 999 queries end a day before the verified local SPK summary; direct source fixtures cover that final day.
The 32-day interior tapers have partial physical-center weight; outside source coverage the model remains target 9.
